name: 42472-toppdecode-8b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine; no speculative decoding and no draft model.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM dense decoder: 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params -- all readable off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 25% by completion, bounded at 2048 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. The warmup percent must satisfy int(percent * max_requests) > streams, so re-derive it if streams moves. About 1792 requests are measured -- read the count off request_latency.successful.count, never as max_requests minus warmup.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, prompt exactly 256 tokens and output exactly 1024 (min = max), temperature 0.7 and top_p 0.95 on every request. ignore_eos is set whenever max_tokens is, so every request emits exactly 1024 tokens. The chat template prepends a dozen-odd tokens, so the engine reports a prompt slightly longer than 256.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on one GPU, generating 1024-token replies from short prompts for 256 concurrent users.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Each value is either what vLLM itself resolves to for this model on
# this card at this version -- written down so an in-process launcher cannot resolve a different
# one -- or a declared choice. Nothing here is tuned. Interpreter and hardware are in env.yaml.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# CHOSEN. Synthetic prompts are drawn fresh per request, so only the chat-template head could
# ever hit; off removes a variable rather than changing the workload.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# CHOSEN. The workload's worst case is 256 prompt + 1024 output tokens; the checkpoint's own
# window is 131072, which would size the block tables for a context this run never reaches.
max-model-len: 2048
